module.live.name: TSQ Live (stream tracking)
module.live.description: Twitch and Kick live-stream announcements: one @everyone per new stream, one message per multistream; title, platform and stream end update the same message.
about.attr.twitch: Twitch live status, title and category (official Twitch Helix API).
about.attr.kick: Kick live status, title and category (official Kick Public API).
live.doctor.title: TSQ Live diagnostics
live.doctor.enabled_off: off (Live:Enabled=false) — no provider requests, no announcements
live.doctor.module_off: disabled — new streams are not announced (/modules enable live)
live.doctor.target_missing: not set (Live:DiscordChannelId and guild) — nothing is announced, the channel is never guessed
live.doctor.target_gone: channel not found or not visible to the bot: {0}
live.doctor.delivery_dry_run: DryRun — announcements are only logged, never sent to Discord
live.doctor.provider_not_configured: no credentials (Client ID/Secret) — this platform is NOT tracked
live.doctor.auth_ok: authorization healthy · token valid until {0} · last validated {1}
live.doctor.auth_failed: authorization FAILED: {0} — check the Client ID/Secret
live.doctor.feed_state: last successful reconciliation {0} · last attempt {1} · consecutive failures {2} · last outcome {3} · last error {4} ({5})
live.doctor.feed_warnings: the provider did not describe some channels: {0}
live.doctor.push_value: no webhook/EventSub (the bot has no public ingress) — official-API reconciliation every {0} s · reconnect grace {1} s
live.doctor.creator: Creator
cmd.live-admin.doctor: Diagnose Twitch/Kick tracking, Discord target and announcements
